data.title: North Korean DMZ landmine blast 'violation of armistice'
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's defence chief said Tuesday that the preliminary findings of an investigation into last week's landmine explosion inside the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) found North Korea responsible, saying the blast violated the armistice agreement.

data.title: Myanmar airstrike death toll rises to 50
data.description: NAY PYI TAW — The death toll from a military airstrike in west Myanmar rose to 50 on Tuesday, two local aid workers at the scene said, the day after it struck a busy market.

data.title: Malaysia begins sending home Myanmar refugees despite safety concerns
data.description: LUMUT, Malaysia - Malaysia began the process of deporting around 1,500 Myanmar nationals on Tuesday as part of a refugee repatriation programme, defying objections from the United Nations and dozens of human rights groups.

data.title: Vietnam arrests three on terrorism charges, including Norwegian and Australian citizens
data.description: HO CHI MINH — Vietnam police have ⁠arrested ⁠three people, including a Norwegian ​citizen and an Australian national of Vietnamese origin, accusing them of terrorism, in ​an operation that a pro-democracy group says ‌was conducted in Cambodia.

data.title: 8.3 million refugees at risk due to 'severe' funding cuts: UN
data.description: GENEVA - Nearly 8.3 million refugees and other forcibly displaced people face losing vital assistance from the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), the UN's refugee agency warned Tuesday, as protection services crumble due to "severe" funding cuts.

data.title: Central Tokyo records 34 consecutive days of rain, longest on record
data.description: Central Tokyo on Tuesday registered 34 consecutive days of rain, marking the longest streak on record, according to the weather agency.

data.title: Brazil's cellphone crime: a security nightmare in every pocket
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO - Eduardo Metzker, 29, was riding his motorcycle in Rio de Janeiro when he was suddenly boxed in by two other bikes. One of the riders put a gun to his head and demanded his phone and passcode.

data.title: Pope says concerns about AI 'should be taken seriously'
data.description: ABOARD THE PAPAL PLANE - Pope Leo XIV on Monday warned concerns about artificial intelligence "should be taken seriously" but added he was not in "panic mode".

data.title: SpaceX puts Starship megarocket in orbit for first time
data.description: SOUTH PADRE ISLAND (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk's Starship megarocket reached orbit for the first time on Monday after blasting off from Texas, in a major milestone for SpaceX's future plans, including trips to the Moon and Mars.

data.title: Dozens kidnapped in two weekend attacks in northern Nigeria
data.description: GUSAU (NIGERIA) - More than 80 people, mostly women, were missing Monday after being abducted by armed gangs in two separate weekend attacks in northern Nigeria, the latest mass kidnappings to rock the country.

data.title: Russia pummels Kyiv in latest deadly daytime attack
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian drones crashed into Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences in the historic heart of Kyiv on Monday, in the latest deadly daytime attack on the Ukrainian capital.

data.title: Seoul says North Korean mines 'highly suspected' as cause of DMZ blast
data.description: SEOUL - A blast that injured three South Korean military officers inside the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) last week was likely caused by North Korean landmines, Seoul's military said Monday.

data.title: Hurricane Polo approaches Mexico, threatens severe damage
data.description: PUERTO SAN CARLOS — Hurricane Polo is expected to make landfall on Monday in a small town off Mexico's Pacific coast, where authorities expect heavy rain and severe damage.

data.title: Madrid housing protesters vow to maintain pressure on government
data.description: MADRID — Demonstrators camping in a central Madrid square vowed Monday to keep up the pressure on Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez over Spain's housing crisis, as the 87-year-old woman at the centre of the protest called on them to "hold on".

data.title: UK police probe Iran link to air base bomb scare
data.description: FAIRFORD (UNITED KINGDOM) - British counter-terror police were reportedly probing Iran's possible role in a bomb scare at an air base used by the US on Monday, with five men detained suspected of planning a "terrorist act".

data.title: Comedian on trial for allegedly insulting Turkish president in standup show
data.description: ISTANBUL - A popular Turkish comedian has been put on trial for allegedly insulting President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and other offences during a stand-up performance, offering a quick-witted defence that had much of the courtroom in stitches.

data.title: Death toll in South Africa bar shooting rises to 18
data.description: JOHANNESBURG — The death toll in a mass shooting in a South African tavern has risen to 18 after one person died in hospital, police said Monday, adding that at least two of the dead were Lesotho nationals.

data.title: Colombian police capture wife, daughter of Ecuador drug lord
data.description: BOGOTá - Colombian police have arrested the wife and daughter of one of Ecuador's most powerful drug lords who was extradited to the United States last year, President Abelardo de la Espriella said Sunday.

data.title: Comedian on trial for insulting Erdogan in standup show
data.description: ISTANBUL — A popular Turkish comedian goes on trial at an Istanbul court on Monday facing charges of insulting President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and other offences during a stand-up performance in June.

data.title: Nothing to seal here: NZ police help stranded pup home
data.description: WELLINGTON — New Zealand police came to the rescue of a seal crossing a busy road, helping the perplexed pinniped pup back safely into the water, they said Monday.

data.title: Seoul seeks apology after Ukraine reveals transfer of North Korean POWs
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's presidential office has demanded an apology from Ukraine for denying an agreement to keep the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul confidential.

data.title: 'Currently impossible': North Korea defections in freefall
data.description: PAJU (SOUTH KOREA) - A building-sized North Korean flag waves from a tower on the de facto border with South Korea, marking territory that experts say has become nearly impossible to escape.

data.title: Pseudo-journalism: Partisan 'news' sites target US midterms
data.description: WASHINGTON - It bills itself as an "independent journalism" outfit, but the innocuous-sounding North Carolinian is among hundreds of partisan sites that researchers say masquerade as local news outlets in battleground states ahead of the US midterm elections.

data.title: Wife of Malaysia's longest-serving PM Mahathir dies at 100
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Siti ⁠Hasmah Mohamad Ali, the wife ​of Malaysia's longest-serving prime minister Mahathir Mohamad, died on Monday, ​the veteran leader's office said.

data.title: Pope to speak on united Europe from French border town
data.description: METZ (FRANCE) - Pope Leo was to speak on Monday about the future of Europe and its integration, giving a distinctly political dimension to a landmark visit to France, which has sparked scenes of spiritual jubilation.

data.title: Washington denounces Iran's truce proposal as 'cynical'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A top US official on Sunday dismissed a proposal for reopening the Strait of Hormuz presented by Iran as "cynical" and indicated it was a non-starter for Washington.

data.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill 8
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian strikes killed eight people across Ukraine a day after Moscow vowed to achieve its war aims "no matter the circumstances", authorities said Sunday.

data.title: UK village on edge over threats to air base in terror alert
data.description: CIRENCESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Residents in a bucolic corner of southwestern England said they were "spooked" by an air base used by the US military in its war against Iran as bomb experts descended on the area on Sunday.

data.title: Serbia's President Aleksandar Vucic announces resignation
data.description: BELGRADE - Serbia's long-time populist President Aleksandar Vucic resigned Sunday to run for prime minister in October snap elections after nearly two years of student-led protests that had been pressing for just such a poll.
